title: Build Context
description: The single as-of time and provenance snapshot a current build resolves once and every downstream script (build_analysis.py, build_dashboard.py, build_review_package.py) reads from, rather than each independently pinning its own notion of 'now' (WO-010-R4 §6).

build_context_id.description: Deterministic from dataset and as_of_time, so rebuilding at the same as-of time for the same dataset reproduces the same ID.

as_of_time.description: The operationally valid 'now' this build treats every freshness, activity and inclusion decision as being measured against. Not the wall clock and not a permanent constant -- resolved once per build, from an explicit --as-of, a carried-forward prior context, or a committed reproducible default.

source_cutoff.description: The cutoff communicated to evidence sources / the review package. Equal to as_of_time unless a build explicitly supersedes it.

generated_at.description: When this context record itself was written. Never earlier than as_of_time.

latest_included_collection_run_at.description: The completed_at of the most recent collection-run manifest this build actually treated as valid (i.e. not future-dated relative to as_of_time). Null when no run qualifies.

latest_included_manual_review_at.description: The reviewed_at of the most recent manual-review event this build actually treated as valid. Null when no event qualifies.

input_hashes.description: SHA-256 of each input file this build actually read, keyed by a short logical name -- lets a reviewer confirm which exact files a committed context was built from.
